svg.title: The LiteX ecosystem
svg.desc: The LiteX ecosystem. In the centre, the LiteX framework (SoC builder, interconnect, in-tree cores, build backends, BIOS and software support, tools). Around it: the cores ecosystem (LiteDRAM, LiteEth, LitePCIe, LiteSATA, LiteSDCard, LiteICLink, LiteJESD204, LiteScope, LiteSPI, LiteI2C, LiteNVMe, LiteDSP, LiteHyperBus), the CPUs (soft RISC-V, OpenRISC, LM32, PowerPC, MIPS cores packaged as pythondata, and the hard CPUs of Zynq, Agilex and Cyclone V), LiteX-Boards with the platform and target files of 200+ boards, the software that runs on the SoCs (BIOS and bare metal, Linux, Zephyr, FreeRTOS, NuttX, MicroPython/CircuitPython, Renode and QEMU simulation) and the host tools. Enjoy-Digital maintains LiteX and most cores, LiteX-Hub hosts the collaborative projects.
